title: What the checks really tell you
summary: Match each test layer to its risk, read coverage honestly, and describe scans without overclaiming.
opening_answer: Unit tests, owned integrations, browser and CLI acceptance, exact-source coverage, image checks and bounded dynamic scans each answer a different question. A passing summary means something only when its scope, source and limits are clear.

blocks.text: Finish: “This check makes me more confident that …”. Cheap checks catch simple mistakes; realistic ones exercise boundaries mocks cannot. None proves everything around it.

Regression: 3,697 passed, 267 subtests, two documented skips in 123.21 s; 177 frontend tests passed. V1: 157 selected cases (99 required); 13 optional short-encoder cases deferred; real PostgreSQL 16 plus Moto S3/SQS, not AWS-managed. blocks.title: Name the boundary
blocks.text: “The database integration passed against local PostgreSQL” is precise; “the AWS database is proven” is not.

sections.title: Coverage is a map, not a grade

blocks.text: Coverage asks which statements and decision outcomes ran. An `if` line can run with one side never taken, so the project tracks raw branch coverage and a combined statement-plus-branch measure. Recovery code needs branches: “lease still current” and “lease expired” must differ.

The combined backend gate joins five source-matched fragments (fast, legacy integration, Processing, Media, V1). The validator checks each fingerprint against current source; a missing fragment or stale fingerprint is an error, so different revisions cannot form a total.

Hosted Main run `39415935595` reports the same coverage for `629119c`; do not attribute local `514914a` evidence to Main. Vitest 4.1.12 changed AST coverage mapping, so frontend figures are a new baseline, not a trend. A green total does not erase a below-goal high-risk module.

combined = (covered statements + covered branches) / (statements + branches)
raw branch = covered branches / all measured branches

Report: threshold + actual + source SHA + contributing test tiers
Coverage does not measure test quality: a line may run without a meaningful assertion. Read it with what tests assert, especially retries, races, ownership and failures.

blocks.q: Why report raw branch coverage separately?
blocks.a: A combined figure can look healthy while a decision exercised only one outcome.

sections.title: Contracts and security checks target different risks

blocks.text: A lost acknowledgement makes a service receive the same instruction twice. Idempotency tests ask whether repeating an operation leaves one correct result; fencing tests ask whether an old worker or stale lease holder is blocked after a newer attempt owns the work.

V1 contract fixtures freeze public messages and response shapes; producer and consumer checks validate envelopes, ownership, source identifiers and attempt/version fields. Persistence tests cover tombstones, replay windows, reservation finalization, late completion. A fixture proves compatibility with the recorded contract, not recovery timing or AWS delivery.

Both analyses skipped in Main CI `39415935595` (no configuration or credentials): NOT_RUN

blocks.text: Exact-config Trivy (20 October): for Media, Processing and worker images, the local scan at `514914a` and the post-deploy scan at `629119c` found zero fixable HIGH/CRITICAL rows. Unfixed rows: 44 Media, 44 Processing, 208 worker in each set; finding rows, not distinct CVEs. “Zero fixable” is not “zero findings.” SARIF triage: see the Security chapter.

sections.title: Dynamic scans have a bounded view

blocks.text: V1 DAST launches a disposable local Gateway/authorizer harness with real PostgreSQL and run-scoped Moto S3/SQS, then a pinned authenticated ZAP scanner against loopback HTTPS. It selects seven eligible GET routes from a 20-operation inventory (15 Media, 5 Processing); state-changing or sensitive routes are blocked or tested with direct fixtures. It does not scan AWS Gateway.

20 October receipt, clean source `514914a`: the first attempt completed Media but stopped before Processing; a separate confirmation completed both: seven routes, 317 handler requests, 146 out-of-scope probes blocked, no in-scope auth denial, server error or request-cap hit. Eight low and eight informational entries remain. Do not merge the two runs into one flawless run.

Hosted Main CI `39415935595` passed its Linux DAST job for `629119c`; the 317-request counts are the local `514914a` confirmation. `NOT_RUN`, excluded routes, emulators and report-only alerts keep their own boundary.

Net lines of code is not a quality score; better evidence is clearer implementation with preserved behavior and tests. Native storage-credential policy 253 to 175 source lines (78 fewer before Ruff formatting); Media asset page uses one owner-local outer join, not an N+1 projection query (SQLite: one SELECT for several page sizes, not PostgreSQL latency); image dependency exports 44 to 40 Media, 36 Processing, 33 worker packages.

spec.caption: Pair a finding with its tool, exact target and execution state.

blocks.q: The DAST inventory says 20 operations. Were all 20 scanned?
blocks.a: No. The inventory has 20; the scan imports seven eligible GET routes. Others are excluded for explicit reasons, with direct contract checks where applicable.

blocks.q: How should I describe SonarCloud when it did not run?
blocks.a: `NOT_RUN`: both advisory analyses were skipped in Main CI `39415935595` (missing configuration or credentials). No Sonar pass is established.

blocks.q: What does zero fixable HIGH/CRITICAL mean?
blocks.a: No HIGH/CRITICAL row had an available fix under the gate. Receipts still list 44/44/208 unfixed rows (Media/Processing/worker), not distinct CVEs.

blocks.q: Why is fewer code not enough to claim better quality?
blocks.a: A LOC total shows neither preserved behavior nor covered failure paths. Cite a concrete simplification (one SELECT for N+1, shared credential code, narrower exports) with tests; do not claim net LOC fell.

takeaways: Layered tests: say what each proves and which environment it touched.
20 October coverage meets the Media/Processing and recovery goals; cite source and scope.
Offline regression, hosted Main CI, deployed-image scans and post-deploy smoke are separate receipts.
Trivy zero-fixable gates coexist with 44/44/208 unfixed rows (not distinct CVEs).
Ruff, Trivy, CodeQL, gitleaks, SonarCloud, ZAP, actionlint and cfn-lint inspect different targets; report NOT_RUN and exclusions.
Simplification claims need specific query, policy and dependency evidence, not net LOC.
